title: The Race for the Third Obesity-Drug Giant: Who Comes After Lilly and Novo Nordisk?
summary: Lilly and Novo Nordisk dominate the first phase of the obesity-drug market. The next investment question is who can become the third major player by solving the problems GLP-1 leaders have not fully solved.
